name: Making A Vow
overview: Scripture teaches that making a vow is a solemn and binding commitment made before the LORD, as seen when individuals dedicate themselves or others to God’s service, such as the Nazarite vow (Numbers 6:2) or other personal pledges (Leviticus 27:2). The seriousness of vows is underscored by the command that one must not break their word but fulfill all promises made to God (Numbers 30:2; Deuteronomy 23:21). The example of Jephthah’s vow (Judges 11:30) further illustrates the gravity and consequences of such commitments, emphasizing that vows are not to be taken lightly but honored faithfully.
